stem: An audit policy requires Aurora backups for 30 days plus immutable long-term monthly copies that never expire until explicitly removed.

choices.text: Keep automated backup retention at 30 days and create monthly cluster snapshots.
Set Aurora automated backup retention to 0 days and rely on weekly exports only.
Use only read replicas as the long-term backup mechanism.
Use ElastiCache snapshots as the authoritative durable archive for relational recovery.

rationale: Aurora supports automated retention windows and manual snapshots that do not expire until deleted, satisfying both operational and long-term needs. Aurora backups cannot be disabled with retention 0 in this context. Read replicas are for scaling and failover, not immutable long-term backup policy. ElastiCache snapshotting is for cache state, not relational system-of-record backup strategy.
